title: nautilus project manifest
description: A manifest-defined nautilus controller: tasks, tags by role, the server, and a configured field driver. Pure data — anything needing computation is generated upstream and committed. Secrets are NEVER in this file: NAUTILUS_TOKEN and NAUTILUS_MQTT_PASSWORD come from the environment.

name.description: The controller's name. Defaults to "nautilus"; also the default Sparkplug edge-node id and the default output name for `nautilus build`.

server.description: The tag API an HMI reads.

tasks.description: One program per scan. The FIRST task is the main task: it owns field I/O and is the default online-edit target.

tag-files.description: Files holding additional tags, each a bare YAML list of the same entries as `tags`. This is where a GENERATED tag set lives, so it stays a separate reviewable artifact instead of a 500-line smear through the file you edit — and how one project ships to several sites, by choosing which tag files a site's manifest composes. Read in order, then `tags` last. A tag declared twice in any two sources is an error: fix the generator, or narrow its scope.

tags.description: Tags declared by role. Hand-authored tags belong here; bulk or generated sets belong in a file listed under `tag-files`.

tag-meta.description: HMI documentation layered onto tags declared elsewhere, keyed by tag name or by a dotted field path (`P101.Speed`). Use it when a generator cannot supply documentation — `nautilus eip import` cannot, because Logix keeps tag descriptions in the offline project file. A generator that HAS descriptions should emit them into its tag file instead. This reaches only unit and desc: it can never change what the controller does.

driver.description: The field driver. Defaults to "memory", the loopback used for bring-up.

sparkplug.description: Republish the tag store as a Sparkplug B edge node.

retain.description: Persist operator state (setpoints, online edits) across restarts: a ConfigMap in a cluster, a JSON file anywhere else. An empty mapping takes both defaults.

file.description: JSON file path outside a cluster (default retain.json).

redundancy.description: Lease-based leader election: replicas elect one scanning leader, the rest stand by. Standalone (always leader) outside a cluster. An empty mapping takes the default lease name.

lease.description: coordination.k8s.io Lease name (default: the project name).

duration.description: A Go duration: "250ms", "2s", "1h30m". A bare number is not one — the unit is required.

addr.description: Listen address for the tag API (default "localhost:8080"). NAUTILUS_ADDR overrides at start.

online-edits.description: Allow a running controller's program to be replaced without a restart.

interval.description: How often the server pushes tag updates to connected clients.

historian.description: Base URL of a `nautilus historian` daemon; GET /api/history* proxies there. NAUTILUS_HISTORIAN_URL overrides.

task.description: One program on its own scan.

name.description: Identifies the task in status and acceptance tests. Defaults to the program's filename. "main" is reserved for the first task.

program.description: The program file in this project — normally .st, .fbd, .ld, or .sfc. The loader requires a PROGRAM declaration inside it, not a particular extension, so none is enforced here.

dt-tag.description: Tag to publish this task's measured scan delta into, for logic that integrates over real elapsed time.

tag.description: One tag, declared by the role it plays in the scan data path.

name.description: The tag name. ST binds it with VAR_EXTERNAL; the driver and HMI address it by this name.

role.description: input: driver → tag each scan, deliberately unseeded so a missing value faults loudly. output: tag → driver each scan; add init when the logic reads it back. setpoint: seeded operator/config value. state: seeded logic-owned value (latches, integrators).

type.description: A UDT declared by this project's ST, for a tag whose value is a struct — the same TYPE the programs bind with VAR_EXTERNAL, so the tag store and the logic cannot disagree about its shape. A typed setpoint or state needs no init: zero-of-type is its seed. A typed input stays unseeded, so a driver that has not delivered still faults loudly.

init.description: Initial value. Required for setpoint and state unless `type` supplies one. On an output, needed only when the logic reads it before writing it (a seal-in latch).

unit.description: Engineering unit shown by an HMI ("°C", "%", "L/s").

desc.description: Human description shown in tag tables.

meta.description: Documentation for one tag or one field of a tag.

unit.description: Engineering unit shown by an HMI ("°C", "%", "L/s").

desc.description: Human description shown in tag tables.

type.description: memory: loopback for bring-up, so logic and HMI run before hardware exists. eip: polls an Allen-Bradley Logix controller. Custom buses are the Go tier.

manifest.description: eip: the imported tag manifest, generated by `nautilus eip import --format yaml`. Any path the project can read; no extension is enforced.

scan-rate.description: eip: default poll period for bound tags.

scan-classes.description: eip: named poll groups and their periods.

tag-classes.description: eip: glob patterns assigning tags to a scan class. Overrides the generated manifest, so imports stay regenerable and policy stays here.

sparkplug.description: Sparkplug B edge node. The MQTT password is NEVER here — set NAUTILUS_MQTT_PASSWORD.

broker.description: Broker URL, e.g. tcp://host:1883 or ssl://host:8883. Passed through to the MQTT client, which decides what it accepts, so no scheme is enforced here.

edge-node.description: Sparkplug edge node id. Defaults to the project name.

client-id.description: MQTT client id. Defaults to something derived from the edge node.

username.description: MQTT username. The password comes from NAUTILUS_MQTT_PASSWORD.

primary-host.description: Gate births on this SCADA host's STATE topic.

publish-interval.description: How often changed metrics are published.

device.description: Publish the field driver's input tags as a Sparkplug DEVICE with this id; its DBIRTH/DDEATH follow the driver's connection health. Empty means everything publishes at node level.

default-class.description: Report-by-exception tuning applied to metrics with no class.

metric-classes.description: Glob patterns assigning metrics to a named class.

min-interval.description: Never publish this metric more often than this.

max-interval.description: Publish at least this often even when unchanged.

every-change.description: Publish every transition unconditionally (alarms, counters) — deadband and min-interval are ignored.
